## History

Superintendent Bell is an acquaintance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who once shared a story from his childhood. As a boy, he broke his ankle, an experience he later related to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_
